description.value: Burrowing Owl Estate Winery is a family-owned premium VQA wine estate in Oliver, at the heart of the South Okanagan cycling corridor, operating since 1993. The property encompasses a wine shop, the Sonora Room fine-dining restaurant, and an 11-room guest house, all situated within the northernmost reach of the antelope brush ecosystem. It is a natural destination stop for cyclists exploring Black Sage Road and the broader Okanagan wine country.
